inputs.goal: add SSO login to the web app in the platform repo

research.research_brief: Researching Single Sign-On (SSO) implementation for web application in platform repository. Need to understand current authentication system, identify SSO protocols (OIDC, SAML, OAuth2) that would integrate with existing platform architecture, and determine compatibility with current tech stack including frontend frameworks, backend services, and database systems. Must also evaluate security implications, user experience impact, and integration complexity with existing user management systems.
research.prior_art: Previous authentication implementations in platform repository include JWT-based token authentication, OAuth2 integration with Google and GitHub, and basic username/password login system. Existing documentation covers session management and role-based access control. SSO implementation should align with current security standards and follow established patterns for API integration and middleware development within the platform architecture.

plan: Research and select SSO protocol (OIDC recommended) compatible with existing platform architecture
Design SSO integration architecture including frontend authentication flow and backend middleware
Implement OIDC client library integration with existing JWT authentication system
Create user management synchronization layer between SSO provider and local user database
Develop authentication middleware to handle SSO token validation and session management
Test SSO integration with multiple identity providers (Google, GitHub, custom IDP)
Update platform documentation with SSO implementation details and user guides
Conduct security audit of SSO implementation against existing security standards
Perform end-to-end testing of SSO login flow including error handling and fallback mechanisms
Prepare rollback plan in case of production deployment issues
acceptance_criteria: SSO login functionality works with at least two identity providers
Existing JWT authentication system remains functional during SSO transition
User management synchronization between SSO provider and local database is accurate
Security audit reports no critical vulnerabilities in SSO implementation
Documentation covers SSO setup, configuration, and troubleshooting steps
End-to-end testing confirms successful login flow with proper error handling
Rollback plan is documented and tested for production deployment failure scenarios
